title: Oedipus fulfills the prophecy by fleeing it
summary: Eric Wargo tells of Oedipus fulfills the prophecy by fleeing it, about mythological antiquity at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's this prophecy that this young prince of Thieves is going to grow up and murder his father and marry his mother

plain: On the show of a podcast host, Jesse Michels, a researcher of dreams and prophecy named Eric Wargo retells the ancient Greek myth of Oedipus, a young prince of the city of Thebes. As Wargo tells it, a prophecy says the prince will grow up to kill his father and marry his mother, and he ends up doing exactly that while trying to escape it. Wargo brings up Sigmund Freud, the founder of psychoanalysis, and uses the story to talk about how foretelling the future might shape it.
